# The sidebar's file tree changes files (Kero's Files), each undoable:
# New File/Folder (a slash makes the folders on the way), Rename in place
# (Esc leaves it), Duplicate, Move to Trash (⌘⌫; a probe's Trash is its
# own folder), and files dropped in from "the Finder" (@FINDER@): copied,
# numbered past a name taken, moved with ⌘. tests/run.sh makes @DIR@
# with a.txt and src/, and @FINDER@ with pic.png.
# (Made again here, so a second attempt — CI retries a failed probe — starts as the first did.)
shell:rm -rf @DIR@ @FINDER@ && mkdir -p @DIR@/src @FINDER@ && echo one > @DIR@/a.txt && echo png > @FINDER@/pic.png
type:cd @DIR@
key:enter
wait:1.0
expect-tree:a.txt
expect-tree:src/
# New File… beside a.txt: docs/ made on the way (and the file opens to be written).
tree-select:a.txt
tree-menu:New File…
sheet-type:docs/notes.md
sheet:Create
expect-tree:docs/notes.md
expect-shell:ls @DIR@/docs ==> notes.md
# A name taken already says so.
tree-select:a.txt
tree-menu:New Folder…
sheet-type:src
sheet:Create
expect-sheet-text:is there already
sheet:OK
# Renamed in place: the stem is selected, so typing replaces it. (type-then:
# the key at once after the text: see UIProbe's typeThen.)
tree-select:a.txt
tree-menu:Rename
type-then:enter:b
expect-tree:b.txt
expect-tree-not:a.txt
undo:go
expect-tree:a.txt
expect-tree-not:b.txt
# Esc leaves the name as it was.
tree-select:a.txt
tree-menu:Rename
type-then:escape:zzz
expect-tree:a.txt
expect-tree-not:zzz.txt
# Return on a selected file renames it too (Finder's key).
tree-select:a.txt
key:enter
type-then:enter:c
expect-tree:c.txt
expect-undo:Rename
undo:go
expect-tree:a.txt
# Duplicate, then ⌘⌫ (and back).
tree-select:a.txt
tree-menu:Duplicate
expect-tree:a copy.txt
expect-undo:Duplicate
tree-select:a copy.txt
key:cmd+backspace
expect-tree-not:a copy.txt
expect-shell:ls @DIR@ ==> a.txt
expect-undo:Move to Trash
undo:go
expect-tree:a copy.txt
# From the Finder: copied into src/, then again as "pic 2.png"; ⌘ moves.
tree-drop:@FINDER@/pic.png>src
expect-tree:src/pic.png
expect-shell:ls @FINDER@ ==> pic.png
tree-drop:@FINDER@/pic.png>src
expect-tree:src/pic 2.png
tree-drop-move:@FINDER@/pic.png>.
expect-tree:pic.png
expect-shell:ls @FINDER@ | wc -l | tr -d ' ' ==> 0
undo:go
expect-tree-not:pic.png
expect-shell:ls @FINDER@ ==> pic.png
# A file open in the editor, renamed: the editor follows it (the same tab,
# its new name), and a save writes the renamed file, not a new one at the
# old name. Undone, it follows the file back. (Renamed as the name typed
# in place renames it, without the field: with an editor open, CI's macOS
# doesn't keep the field's keyboard in a window that isn't key, as a
# probe's never is. Typing the name is above.)
open:@DIR@/docs/notes.md
editor-wait:go
expect-tab-count:2
tab:1
wait:0.5
expect-tree:docs/notes.md
tree-rename:docs/notes.md:renamed.md
expect-tree:docs/renamed.md
expect-tab:renamed.md
open:@DIR@/docs/renamed.md
editor-wait:go
expect-tab-count:2
editor-insert:after the rename
editor-save:go
expect-file:@DIR@/docs/renamed.md=after the rename
expect-shell:ls @DIR@/docs ==> renamed.md
expect-shell:test -e @DIR@/docs/notes.md && echo back || echo gone ==> gone
undo:go
wait:0.5
expect-shell:ls @DIR@/docs ==> notes.md
expect-tab:notes.md
editor-insert:back again
editor-save:go
expect-file:@DIR@/docs/notes.md=back again
expect-shell:test -e @DIR@/docs/renamed.md && echo there || echo gone ==> gone
